name: @mzizi/dryv
description: Dryv contracts for the Mzizi canonical knowledge model (TypeScript authoring).

scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run contracts:audit && bun run contracts:doctor && bun run contracts:compile > /dev/null && bun run access:check && bun run boundary:check && bun run schema:check
scripts.database:check: bun run typecheck && bun run database:format:check && bun run database:doctor && bun run database:compile > /dev/null
scripts.database:format: bunx --bun @biomejs/biome format --write contracts/schemas/_shared.ts contracts/schemas/operational/*.ts contracts/apps/database/index.ts package.json
scripts.database:format:check: bunx --bun @biomejs/biome format contracts/schemas/_shared.ts contracts/schemas/operational/*.ts contracts/apps/database/index.ts package.json
